hearing.name: A Stay of Collection
hearing.summary: Secure time to challenge the archlord without transferring Rowan to him.

stages.text: Hear Seris and Rowan, then examine the ledger.
Ask the registrar to stay collection. Address the missing testimony if necessary.
Let Rowan decide where to go during the stay.

restitution.name: The First Name
restitution.summary: Preserve the record of a soul Seris collected. A name is the beginning of restitution, not absolution.

stages.text: Read the ledger and preserve the victim’s testimony.

docket.name: The Missing Counterseal
docket.summary: Find proof that the archlord claimed authority he was never granted.

stages.text: Ask the market clerk about the missing counterseal.
Recover the counterseal from the Counting House vault.

mara.name: A Name Is Not a Number
mara.summary: Recover Mara’s memory and release her captive soul.

stages.text: Meet Mara’s sister at the old ferry.
Find Mara’s soul lantern in the vault.
Release her at the sanctuary. Let her choose whether to speak.

bloodline.name: The Ancestor’s Signature
bloodline.summary: Learn what Seris’s ancestor actually promised.

stages.text: Explore the ancestral manor; read all three inscriptions.
Open the family archive using its three principles.

appeal.name: Against the Future
appeal.summary: Bring the original grant, counterseal and testimony to the tribunal.

stages.text: Find the counterseal, original grant and a free witness’s testimony.
Enter the tribunal and challenge both claims together.

bell.name: The Ferryman’s Bell
bell.summary: Return a stolen memorial bell without collecting another debt.

stages.text: Find the bell among the ferry ruins.

names.name: The Other Names
names.summary: Copy the vault’s register so the rescue does not end with two people.

stages.text: Preserve the register in the Counting House.
Entrust the names to the sanctuary keeper.
